# ad_gpo_registry_value (Resource)

`ad_gpo_registry_value` manages a single registry-based policy setting (Administrative Template) inside a Group Policy Object.

Each instance manages one value, identified by the GPO, the registry key and the value name. The underlying `registry.pol` file and the GPO version are maintained by the GroupPolicy PowerShell cmdlets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ad_gpo" "g" {
  name        = "registrytestGPO"
  domain      = "yourdomain.com"
  description = "gpo for registry value tests"
  status      = "AllSettingsEnabled"
}

# A DWORD setting: disable the lock screen camera.
resource "ad_gpo_registry_value" "no_lock_screen_camera" {
  gpo_guid   = ad_gpo.g.id
  key        = "HKLM\\Software\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows\\Personalization"
  value_name = "NoLockScreenCamera"
  type       = "DWord"
  value      = ["1"]
}

# A multi-valued setting.
resource "ad_gpo_registry_value" "example_multistring" {
  gpo_guid   = ad_gpo.g.id
  key        = "HKLM\\Software\\Policies\\Example"
  value_name = "AllowedHosts"
  type       = "MultiString"
  value      = ["host1.example.com", "host2.example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gpo_guid` (String) The GUID of the GPO that will hold the registry setting.
- `key` (String) The registry key, e.g. `HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\...`.
- `type` (String) The registry value type. One of `String`, `ExpandString`, `DWord`, `MultiString`, or `QWord` (case sensitive).
- `value` (List of String) The value(s) of the registry setting. Single-valued types (`String`, `ExpandString`, `DWord`, `QWord`) expect exactly one element; `MultiString` accepts several. Numeric values are given as decimal strings.
- `value_name` (String) The name of the registry value to manage under `key`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# The ID for this resource is comprised of the GPO GUID, the registry key and the
# value name, separated by forward slashes: <gpo_guid>/<key>/<value_name>
$ terraform import ad_gpo_registry_value.example '9CB8219C-31FF-4A85-A7A3-9BCBB6A41D02/HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Personalization/NoLockScreenCamera'
```
